definitions.explanation: Machining a rotating workpiece with a fixed cutting tool on a lathe ({旋盤|せんばん}). One of the main types of {切削|せっさく} (cutting), best suited to round parts. Takes する to form a verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旋盤|せんばん}→旋盤：26174_senban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旋削|せんさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To turn a shaft on a lathe.

examples.japanese: {旋削|せんさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Turning is well suited to making round parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旋削|せんさく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: At this factory they turn metal rods on a lathe to finish them into parts.

notes:
Cutting a rotating workpiece with a fixed tool on a lathe; a type of ⟦{切削|せっさく}→切削：29604_sessaku⟧. Not to be confused with the homophone {詮索|せんさく} (prying).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旋削|せんさく}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: turning work
- ⟦{旋盤|せんばん}→旋盤：26174_senban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{旋削|せんさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn on a lathe

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{切削|せっさく}→切削：29604_sessaku⟧: cutting; machining — the broader category
- ⟦{旋盤|せんばん}→旋盤：26174_senban⟧: lathe — the machine used for turning
